conclusion: The visually inspected Teacher character rasters have no scored source-pixel dimension below 4.5. The procedural instructional geometry is semantically clear in code but has no raster-art score, and the SVG launcher was not rendered for this pass. Board presentation, pointer-to-target ownership, animation, Mobile mounting and phone readability therefore remain UNASSESSED rather than failed. Full Teacher acceptance remains OPEN.
